title.install: Install Salty OS on your NumWorks calculator
description.index: Salty OS is a custom userland for your NumWorks calculator, with themes, symbolic calculation, external apps and more.
description.browse: Discover all community-made themes for Salty OS and download the ones you like.
description.install: Install Salty OS on your NumWorks calculator to unlock themes, symbolic calculation, external apps and more.
description.new: Design your own theme for Salty OS with custom colors, icons and wallpaper.
description.package: Build a custom pack of themes for Salty OS and install your favorites on your NumWorks calculator.
home.subtitle: An upgraded OS for your calculator
